analysis.title: Amphenol Corp. (APH): 3Q26 First Take
key_insights: Amphenol (APH, Buy) reported 3Q26 revenue of $10,230 mn, up 17% qoq, up 65% yoy and up 37% organically. That was 8% above both GS ($9,475 mn) and FactSet consensus ($9,491 mn), and above the company's own guidance of $9,300-$9,400 mn.
Orders hit a record $12.2 bn in 3Q26 for a book-to-bill of 1.19x. The company's release credits exceptional organic growth in the IT datacom market, plus acquisitions.
Adjusted operating margin was 29.7% vs 29.1% for both GS and the Street, a 60 bps beat. Non-GAAP operating income was $3,036 mn vs GS $2,754 mn and Street $2,763 mn.
Non-GAAP operating EPS was $0.80, above the high end of the $0.70-$0.71 guidance range, GS at $0.72 and the Street at $0.73.

4Q26 revenue guidance is $10,300-$10,500 mn, 5% above GS ($9,899 mn) and 6% above the Street ($9,771 mn) at the midpoint. EPS guidance of $0.81-$0.83 is $0.06 above GS ($0.76) and $0.07 above the Street ($0.75). Guidance excludes the three acquisitions not yet closed.
Amphenol raised its CommScope expectation to 2026 sales of $5.1 bn and EPS of $0.18, from $4.6 bn and $0.15 previously.
3Q26 free cash flow was about $1,623 mn (about 16% of revenue). The company spent $245 mn on buybacks and $308 mn on dividends.

Capital return: the quarterly dividend rises to $0.15 per share from $0.125. A new $4 bn, 3-year repurchase program starts January 1, and the remaining $2 bn of the existing plan is expected to be finished by year-end.

M&A: Empire Electronics (automotive lighting interconnects, about $320 mn FY26 sales) closed in the quarter. Agreements were signed for AdvancedPCB (about $270 mn sales, closing 4Q26), Dexgreen (about $90 mn, closing 1Q27) and Humanetics Sensors (about $70 mn, closing 4Q26). The three cost about $1.6 bn combined, funded with cash and debt.

GS expects the stock to trade higher on the results and guidance. Investor focus on the call (1:00 PM ET) should be the sustainability of overall and AI datacenter demand, traction in the fiber portfolio, margins and input costs, and supply chain.
GS keeps a Buy and a $116 12-month price target, based on 30x normalized EPS of $3.85. Against the $78.21 close on 27 Oct 2026 that implies 48.3% upside.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 revenue, margin and EPS beat, 4Q26 guidance well above GS and the Street, and record orders. The target is 30x normalized EPS of $3.85.

APH 3Q26 reported revenue $10,229.7 mn vs GS estimate $9,475.1 mn and FactSet consensus estimate $9,491.0 mn (8.0% and 7.8% above). Reported 10/28/2026.
APH 3Q26 reported non-GAAP operating margin 29.7% vs GS and FactSet consensus estimates of 29.1%.

APH 4Q26 company guidance: revenue $10,300-$10,500 mn and operating EPS $0.81-$0.83. Midpoint revenue is 5.1% above GS estimate ($9,899.1 mn) and 6.4% above FactSet consensus estimate ($9,771.0 mn). Midpoint EPS $0.82 vs GS estimate $0.76 and consensus estimate $0.75.
Orders of $12.2 bn in 3Q26 (reported) were up 13.7% qoq and 99.6% yoy, with book-to-bill of 1.19x.
GS forecasts: 3Q26E EPS $0.72 and 4Q26E $0.76 (both pre-print estimates). FY26E EPS $2.70, FY27E $3.50, FY28E $4.00 vs $1.67 in FY25 (reported).
risk_factors: Margin pressure, with input costs a call topic
US-China trade situation, given Amphenol's several manufacturing sites in China
Ability to keep executing on M&A, including the pending AdvancedPCB, Dexgreen and Humanetics Sensors deals
